summary: Tested 2 new features: (1) Crystal deep profiles expanded from 20 to 27 — all 7 new crystals confirmed (Aquamarine, Kunzite, Iolite, Amazonite, Howlite, Kyanite, Angelite); (2) ShareToCircle modal on both Chakra Cleansing and Courses pages — full end-to-end flow verified including share button visibility, modal elements, form validation, POST to /api/community/posts, success toast, and modal close. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: The 'element', 'author_name', and 'tags' fields sent by ShareToCircle are accepted in the request but NOT stored in the database or returned in the response. The backend only stores: id, title, content, author, type, practice_type, moon_phase, mood, likes, comments, status, created_at. ShareToCircle component sends element and author_name but they are silently dropped.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>/<select>'. This comes from a visual editor overlay injecting spans inside the select element — not from the actual app code. No functional impact.

action_items: MINOR: Update POST /api/community/posts backend handler to also store 'element', 'author_name', and 'tags' fields from the request payload — currently these are silently dropped. ShareToCircle component correctly sends them but they are not persisted.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend create_community_post handler (content.py ~line 784) only stores a hardcoded set of fields and ignores 'element', 'author_name', 'tags' from the request. These should be persisted so community posts can be filtered by element and credited to author_name.
The hydration warning for <span> inside <select>/<option> appears to come from the visual editor overlay injecting extra spans — not from actual app code. Not a code quality issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All flows verified: crystals deep 27 count, chakra share modal, course share modal, form validation, POST submission, success toast, modal close

test_credentials: No login required for Chakra Cleansing, Courses, or Community posts endpoints
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several TEST_ prefixed community posts for testing (POST /api/community/posts). These are visible in the community page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 feature sets are working: (1) GET /api/crystals/deep returns 27 crystals; the data is in /app/backend/data/crystals_deep.py with 27 entries; (2) ChakraCleansing page has chakra-share-btn in the bottom action row of the detail modal — opens ShareToCircle at z-[60]; (3) Courses page has course-share-btn as an absolute-positioned circular button in the top-right of the modal image area (right-14, adjacent to close button) — opens ShareToCircle pre-filled with course title; (4) ShareToCircle component posts to /api/community/posts — works correctly but element/author_name/tags fields are silently dropped by backend.
